name: TNS Energo
verdict: Sleeve partner through its Voronezh subsidiary. Russian listed energy-sales holding; largest shareholder a private company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: ПАО «ТНС Энерго Воронеж» is the club-facing entity; parent is PJSC GK TNS Energo. Former co-owner Dmitry Arzhanov was convicted of fraud in August 2026 (criminal, financial record — does not count as a human-rights record). Ownership currently contested in court between FinAlyans ST and Sunflake Limited.
